policies.title: Standard returns and refunds
policies.text: Allow a refund for an unused item requested within 30 calendar days of delivery when the order identifier and delivery timing are provided. Deny requests made after 30 days. Escalate when the order identifier or delivery timing is missing.

policies.title: Damaged item resolution
policies.text: Allow a replacement or refund when damage is reported within 14 calendar days of delivery and an order identifier is provided. Escalate if the order identifier or delivery timing is missing.

policies.title: Delayed and missing deliveries
policies.text: Allow a carrier investigation when an order is past its promised delivery date and tracking remains in transit. Escalate when tracking reports delivery but the customer reports non-receipt, or when fulfillment information conflicts.

policies.title: Order cancellation
policies.text: Allow cancellation before shipment. Deny cancellation after shipment and direct the customer to the applicable return policy. Escalate when shipment state is missing or contradictory.

policies.title: Duplicate billing
policies.text: Allow reversal of a duplicate charge when the order identifier, matching amounts, and charge dates are supplied. Escalate when the duplicate cannot be tied to an order or the charge details are incomplete.

policies.title: Account access and recovery
policies.text: Provide password-reset guidance when the customer controls the registered email and reports no compromise. Escalate suspected account takeover, unauthorized profile changes, or inability to access the registered email.

policies.title: Supported request scope
policies.text: Supported categories are refunds, damaged orders, delivery delays, cancellations, billing, and account access. Escalate requests outside these categories rather than inventing a policy or resolution.
